warranty.notes: 70% of usable energy at 10 years or the Minimum Throughput Energy, whichever comes first. 16 MWh per 5.12 kWh module. Throughput is the battery's total output (discharged) energy recorded by its control module, from the warranty start date (the earlier of installation or six months after production).

sources.title: Deye ESS battery limited warranty, SE-G5.1Pro-B

notes: Low-voltage 51.2 V rack/wall module, 5.12 kWh. Up to 64 in parallel (327 kWh). The warranty table gives 5.12 kWh usable; the global datasheet gives 4.6 kWh at 90% depth of discharge.
